episodeTitle.en: Why the next AI boom is physical AI | Caitlin Kalinowski (ex-OpenAI, Meta, Apple)
episodeTitle.zh: 下一场AI热潮将是物理AI | 凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基（曾任OpenAI、Meta、苹果公司）

guestBioOfficial.en: Caitlin Kalinowski was most recently at OpenAI helping build their robotics and hardware teams from scratch. Prior to that, she was head of AR glasses and VR hardware at Meta, where she led the teams building every generation of the Quest, Rift, and Orion, and was Meta’s first consumer electronics hire. Before this, she was  technical lead on MacBook Air and Mac Pro at Apple, and helped engineer the original unibody MacBook Pro. She’s designed and engineered some of the hardest and most beloved consumer hardware products in history and is now focused on the next frontier: robotics. *In our in-depth conversation, we discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基最近在OpenAI工作，帮助从零开始组建其机器人与硬件团队。在此之前，她曾担任Meta公司的AR眼镜和VR硬件部门负责人，领导团队开发了每一代Quest、Rift和Orion产品，也是Meta公司首位消费电子产品领域的招聘人员。此前，她在苹果公司担任MacBook Air和Mac Pro的技术主管，并参与设计了首款一体式MacBook Pro。她设计并开发了历史上一些最具挑战性和最受欢迎的消费硬件产品，如今专注于下一个前沿领域——机器人技术。在我们的深度对话中，我们探讨了：

title.en: Why the next AI boom is physical AI | Caitlin Kalinowski (ex-OpenAI, Meta, Apple)
title.zh: 下一场AI热潮将是物理AI | 凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基（曾任OpenAI、Meta、苹果公司）

summary.en: Caitlin argues that as what's possible behind a keyboard with AI saturates, the next frontier is the physical world—robotics, manufacturing, and reindustrialization. She shares what made Steve Jobs' bar for talent and excellence unwavering and how Sam Altman pushes people to think 100x bigger. The conversation covers why design for physical AI matters, the coming “meteor” of memory-price constraints, and national security implications of reindustrialization.
summary.zh: Caitlin 认为，当键盘后靠 AI 能做的事趋于饱和，下一个前沿是物理世界——机器人、制造和再工业化。她分享了 Steve Jobs 对人才与卓越毫不退让的标准，以及 Sam Altman 如何逼人把想法放大 100 倍。对话涵盖物理 AI 的设计为何重要、即将到来的“内存价格流星”约束，以及再工业化的国家安全含义。
